answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with random walks stopped after a fixed number of steps, preventing distant endorsements from amplifying without bound. A sybil cluster connected to honest nodes by a narrow, low-conductance cut receives little walk probability across its boundary; with normalized votes and capped edge influence, its aggregate weight is bounded by incoming cut flow, not internal size. A beacon may guide traversal, but cannot make the cluster a harbor of unearned trust—or a jetty to the honest graph.
